title: Rabbi Chiyya, Father of Rabbi Berekhyah
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: In Vayikra Rabbah, beginning of chapter 30: Rabbi Berekhyah and his father Rabbi Chiyya in the name of Rabbi Yose ben Nehorai. In Tanchuma, Chayei Sarah 6: Rabbi Berekhyah HaKohen said in the name of his father Rabbi Chiyya, who said in the name of Rav Yehudah bar Yechezkel.

notes.text: The Tanchuma Buber transcription for Chayei Sarah, in the section on ‘I will make you a great nation,’ gives the same chain from Berekhyah through Chiyya to Yehudah and continues with another attribution. Hyman cites Chayei Sarah 6.
